text:
3. 2. 2

Sukhitasuttaṃ

275. Sāvatthiyaṃ-

Anamataggoyaṃ bhikkhave, saṃsāro. Pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ. Yaṃ bhikkhave, passeyyātha sukhitaṃ sajjitaṃ, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ ''amhehipi evarūpaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ iminā dīghena addhunā''ti. Taṃ kissa hetu? Anamataggoyaṃ bhikkhave, saṃsāro. Pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ. Yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibibindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccitunti.
